description: Remove indexed content from the user's knowledge base by source_id or thread_id (from mRAG_list_sources). Deletes every embedded chunk for that source so mRAG_search can no longer recall it. Requires source_id or thread_id (will not purge the whole index). Returns the number of chunks deleted. Owner-scoped.

source_id.description: Delete every indexed chunk with this source_id (from mRAG_list_sources).

thread_id.description: Delete every indexed chunk associated with this thread_id.

name: mRAG_delete
